title: VINTAGE MODEL HOOVER WASHING M...
reason: Boxed Mettoy tinplate toy Hoover washing machine (carton says Made in Gt. Britain by the Mettoy Co. Ltd., Swansea), a collectable vintage toy the title does not identify.
findings: The washing machine is a tinplate toy: white enamel body, red HOOVER name badge, grey top tub, hand cranked wringer with red handle, side crank, black base and a separate grey base plate. It comes with its original printed carton reading MODEL HOOVER, registered trade mark of Hoover Ltd., WASHING MACHINE, with Made in Gt. Britain by the Mettoy Co. Ltd., Swansea at the lower right. So it is a Mettoy made licensed Hoover toy, boxed; the title does not mention Mettoy or the original carton. The chair is a blue painted tubular steel frame with a plywood seat and plastic feet, school chair style, no label seen.
condition: Machine has rust spotting and chips along the door seam and edges plus paint wear; carton torn at the top flaps, soiled and creased; chair paint flaking and seat worn; completeness of accessories unknown.
